title: Comparing Segment and Dimension Transaction and Reporting between Dynamics GP and Business Central

chapters.title: Posting transactions with segments in Dynamics GP
Overview of dimensions in Business Central
Setting up default dimensions on vendors
Creating purchase invoices with default dimensions
Viewing transactions in trial balance dimension report

features.name: Default dimensions on vendors
features.description: Ability to assign default dimension values to vendors in Business Central that automatically default onto purchase transactions, replacing the segment posting functionality from Dynamics GP.

features.name: Dimension value posting code settings
features.description: Option to set dimension value posting code to mandatory to enforce that a dimension value must exist on transactions for an entity, or leave it flexible for defaulting only.
caveats: Not demonstrated with mandatory setting applied

features.name: Dimension value migration from GP
features.description: Segments defined in Dynamics GP migrate to Business Central as dimensions through the cloud migration tool, allowing continuation of transaction categorization.

features.name: Posting preview in purchase journal
features.description: Ability to preview posting before submitting a journal entry in Business Central to verify correct accounts and dimension values are being posted, similar to GP distributions button.

features.name: Trial balance dimension report
features.description: Report in Business Central that displays amounts posted to main accounts and allows analysis of transactions by various dimensions such as division, enabling slice-and-dice reporting similar to GP segment reporting.
